  /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n27\t    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n28\t\n29\t    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n85\t        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n86\t\n87\t        uint256 fee = \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/utils/SafeERC20.sol\";\nimport {Math} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/math/Math.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\nimport {ReentrancyGuard} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/ReentrancyGuard.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"./interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @title UsdtYieldVault\n/// @notice Pooled USDT vault that routes deposits into Aave V3 and tracks\n///         depositor ownership with internal shares.\n/// @dev Shares carry 18 decimals while USDT carries 6, so the first depositor\n///      mints at `SHARE_SCALE`. Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to\n///      the remaining shareholders rather than being swept to the owner.\ncontract UsdtYieldVault is Ownable, Pausable, ReentrancyGuard {\n    using SafeERC20 for IERC20;\n    using Math for uint256;\n\n    /// @notice Denominator for all basis-point maths.\n    uint256 public constant BPS_DENOMINATOR = 10_000;\n\n    /// @notice Scaling factor between 6-decimal USDT and 18-decimal shares.\n    uint256 public constant SHARE_SCALE = 1e12;\n\n    /// @notice Smallest accepted deposit, in USDT base units (1 USDT).\n    uint256 public constant MIN_DEPOSIT = 1e6;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on withdrawal, in basis points.\n    uint256 public constant WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS = 30;\n\n    uint16 private constant AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE = 0;\n\n    /// @notice The underlying asset (USDT).\n    IERC20 public immutable usdt;\n\n    /// @notice The interest-bearing Aave receipt token for `usdt`.\n    IERC20 public immutable aUsdt;\n\n    /// @notice The Aave V3 lending pool deposits are routed through.\n    IAavePool public immutable aavePool;\n\n    /// @notice Fee charged on deposit, in basis points.\n    uint256 public depositFeeBps;\n\n    /// @notice Total shares outstanding across all depositors.\n    uint256 public totalShares;\n\n    /// @notice Vault-tracked USDT supplied to Aave, in USDT base units.\n    uint256 public totalAssetsStored;\n\n    /// @notice Shares held per depositor.\n    mapping(address account => uint256 shares) public shareBalance;\n\n    event Deposited(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event Withdrawn(address indexed account, uint256 assets, uint256 shares, uint256 fee);\n    event DepositFeeUpdated(uint256 previousFeeBps, uint256 newFeeBps);\n\n    error AmountBelowMinimum();\n    error NoSharesMinted();\n    error ZeroShares();\n    error InsufficientShares();\n\n    /// @param _usdt The underlying USDT token.\n    /// @param _aUsdt The Aave aUSDT receipt token.\n    /// @param _aavePool The Aave V3 pool.\n    /// @param _depositFeeBps Initial deposit fee in basis points.\n    /// @param initialOwner Address granted ownership.\n    constructor(address _usdt, address _aUsdt, address _aavePool, uint256 _depositFeeBps, address initialOwner)\n        Ownable(initialOwner)\n    {\n        usdt = IERC20(_usdt);\n        aUsdt = IERC20(_aUsdt);\n        aavePool = IAavePool(_aavePool);\n        depositFeeBps = _depositFeeBps;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Supplies `amount` of USDT into the vault and mints shares to the caller.\n    /// @param amount Amount of USDT to deposit, in base units.\n    /// @return shares Number of shares minted to the caller.\n    function deposit(uint256 amount) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 shares) {\n        if (amount < MIN_DEPOSIT) revert AmountBelowMinimum();\n\n        uint256 fee = (amount * depositFeeBps) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        uint256 netAmount = amount - fee;\n\n        shares = convertToShares(netAmount);\n        if (shares == 0) revert NoSharesMinted();\n\n        usdt.safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount);\n        aavePool.supply(address(usdt), amount, address(this), AAVE_REFERRAL_CODE);\n\n        totalAssetsStored += amount;\n        totalShares += shares;\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] += shares;\n\n        emit Deposited(msg.sender, amount, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Burns `shares` and returns the underlying USDT, net of the withdrawal fee.\n    /// @param shares Number of shares to burn.\n    /// @return netAssets USDT sent to the caller, in base units.\n    function withdraw(uint256 shares) external whenNotPaused nonReentrant returns (uint256 netAssets) {\n        if (shares == 0) revert ZeroShares();\n        if (shareBalance[msg.sender] < shares) revert InsufficientShares();\n\n        uint256 grossAssets = convertToAssets(shares);\n        uint256 fee = (grossAssets * WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS) / BPS_DENOMINATOR;\n        netAssets = grossAssets - fee;\n\n        shareBalance[msg.sender] -= shares;\n        totalShares -= shares;\n        totalAssetsStored -= grossAssets;\n\n        aavePool.withdraw(address(usdt), netAssets, msg.sender);\n\n        emit Withdrawn(msg.sender, netAssets, shares, fee);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Updates the deposit fee.\n    /// @param newFeeBps New deposit fee in basis points.\n    function setDepositFee(uint256 newFeeBps) external onlyOwner {\n        uint256 previousFeeBps = depositFeeBps;\n        depositFeeBps = newFeeBps;\n        emit DepositFeeUpdated(previousFeeBps, newFeeBps);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Pauses deposits and withdrawals.\n    function pause() external onlyOwner {\n        _pause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Resumes deposits and withdrawals.\n    function unpause() external onlyOwner {\n        _unpause();\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT currently tracked by the vault, in base units.\n    function totalAssets() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return totalAssetsStored;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts a USDT amount into shares at the current share price.\n    /// @param assets USDT amount in base units.\n    /// @return Shares corresponding to `assets`.\n    function convertToShares(uint256 assets) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return assets * SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return assets.mulDiv(totalShares, totalAssetsStored);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Converts shares into a USDT amount at the current share price.\n    /// @param shares Share amount.\n    /// @return USDT in base units corresponding to `shares`.\n    function convertToAssets(uint256 shares) public view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) {\n            return shares / SHARE_SCALE;\n        }\n        return shares.mulDiv(totalAssetsStored, totalShares);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice USDT value currently redeemable by `account`, before the withdrawal fee.\n    function balanceOfUnderlying(address account) external view returns (uint256) {\n        return convertToAssets(shareBalance[account]);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Current share price, expressed as USDT base units per 1e18 shares.\n    function sharePrice() external view returns (uint256) {\n        if (totalShares == 0) return 1e18 / SHARE_SCALE;\n        return totalAssetsStored.mulDiv(1e18, totalShares);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":178,"startLine":1,"totalLines":178}}}

SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {Ownable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/access/Ownable.sol\";\nimport {Pausable} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/utils/Pausable.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\ncontract UsdtYieldVaultTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault public vault;\n    MockUSDT public usdt;\n    MockAavePool public pool;\n    MockAToken public aUsdt;\n\n    address public owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address public alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address public bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 public constant INITIAL_FEE_BPS = 10;\n    uint256 public constant DEPOSIT_AMOUNT = 1_000e6;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), INITIAL_FEE_BPS, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    function _deposit(address account, uint256 amount) internal returns (uint256) {\n        vm.prank(account);\n        return vault.deposit(amount);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              CONSTRUCTOR\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.usdt()), address(usdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aUsdt()), address(aUsdt));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsAavePool() public view {\n        assertEq(address(vault.aavePool()), address(pool));\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsOwner() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.owner(), owner);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConstructorSetsDepositFee() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), INITIAL_FEE_BPS);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                               CONSTANTS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_BpsDenominator() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.BPS_DENOMINATOR(), 10_000);\n    }\n\n    function test_ShareScale() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.SHARE_SCALE(), 1e12);\n    }\n\n    function test_MinDeposit() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.MIN_DEPOSIT(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawFeeBps() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.WITHDRAW_FEE_BPS(), 30);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                DEPOSIT\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_DepositMintsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositUpdatesTotalAssets() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssetsStored(), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositTransfersUsdtFromDepositor() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore - DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositSuppliesToAave() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_DepositEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Deposited(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT, 999e18, 1e6);\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_SecondDepositorMintsShares() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(bob, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(shares, 0);\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(bob), shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_DepositBelowMinimum() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.AmountBelowMinimum.selector);\n        vault.deposit(1e6 - 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                WITHDRAW\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_WithdrawReturnsUsdt() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 netAssets = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(netAssets, 997e6);\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(alice), balanceBefore + 997e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawBurnsShares() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), 0);\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_WithdrawEmitsEvent() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.expectEmit(true, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.Withdrawn(alice, 997e6, shares, 3e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n    }\n\n    function test_PartialWithdraw() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares / 2);\n\n        assertEq(vault.shareBalance(alice), shares / 2);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawZeroShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.ZeroShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(0);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_WithdrawExceedsBalance() public {\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(UsdtYieldVault.InsufficientShares.selector);\n        vault.withdraw(shares + 1);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  FEES\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeUpdatesValue() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n        assertEq(vault.depositFeeBps(), 25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeEmitsEvent() public {\n        vm.expectEmit(false, false, false, true, address(vault));\n        emit UsdtYieldVault.DepositFeeUpdated(INITIAL_FEE_BPS, 25);\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    function test_SetDepositFeeToZero() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.setDepositFee(0);\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 1_000e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerSetsDepositFee() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.setDepositFee(25);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                 PAUSING\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_PauseBlocksDeposit() public {\n        vm.prank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(Pausable.EnforcedPause.selector);\n        vault.deposit(DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_UnpauseRestoresDeposit() public {\n        vm.startPrank(owner);\n        vault.pause();\n        vault.unpause();\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 shares = _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_RevertWhen_NonOwnerPauses() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vm.expectRevert(abi.encodeWithSelector(Ownable.OwnableUnauthorizedAccount.selector, alice));\n        vault.pause();\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                                  VIEWS\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_TotalAssetsStartsAtZero() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.totalAssets(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceStartsAtOneUsdt() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.sharePrice(), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_SharePriceAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.sharePrice(), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 1e18);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsEmptyVault() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 1e6);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToSharesAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToShares(1e6), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_ConvertToAssetsAfterDeposit() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertGt(vault.convertToAssets(1e18), 0);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlying() public {\n        _deposit(alice, DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice), DEPOSIT_AMOUNT);\n    }\n\n    function test_BalanceOfUnderlyingIsZeroForNonDepositor() public view {\n        assertEq(vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob), 0);\n    }\n}\n","numLines":300,"startLine":1,"totalLines":300}}}

0.8.28;\n3\t\n4\timport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\n5\timport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n6\t\n7\timport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n8\t\n9\t/// @notice Receipt token minted by {MockAavePool}, mirroring aUSDT.\n10\tcontract MockAToken is ERC20 {\n11\t    address public immutable pool;\n12\t\n13\t    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n14\t        pool = _pool;\n15\t    }\n16\t\n17\t    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n18\t        return 6;\n19\t    }\n20\t\n21\t    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n22\t        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n23\t        _mint(to, amount);\n24\t    }\n25\t\n26\t    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n27\t        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n28\t        _burn(from, amount);\n29\t    }\n30\t}\n31\t\n32\t/// @notice Stand-in for the Aave V3 pool used across the test suite.\n33\tcontract MockAavePool is IAavePool {\n34\t    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n35\t    MockAToken public immutable aToken;\n36\t\n37\t    constructor(address _underlying) {\n38\t        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n39\t        aToken = new MockAToken(address(this));\n40\t    }\n41\t\n42\t    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n43\t        underlying.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n44\t        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n45\t    }\n46\t\n47\t    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n48\t        aToken.burn(msg.sender, amount);\n49\t        underlying.transfer(to, amount);\n50\t        return amount;\n51\t SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {ERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/ERC20.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Receipt token minted by {MockAavePool}, mirroring aUSDT.\ncontract MockAToken is ERC20 {\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    constructor(address _pool) ERC20(\"Aave Tether USD\", \"aUSDT\") {\n        pool = _pool;\n    }\n\n    function decimals() public pure override returns (uint8) {\n        return 6;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _mint(to, amount);\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        _burn(from, amount);\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Stand-in for the Aave V3 pool used across the test suite.\ncontract MockAavePool is IAavePool {\n    IERC20 public immutable underlying;\n    MockAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying) {\n        underlying = IERC20(_underlying);\n        aToken = new MockAToken(address(this));\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        underlying.transferFrom(msg.sender, address(this), amount);\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burn(msg.sender, amount);\n        underlying.transfer(to, amount);\n        return amount;\n    }\n}\n","numLines":53,"startLine":1,"totalLines":53}}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSETS1R4UXKDWGMLJHV4","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01FJ4vurqDZzkxgsYXWfaDXE","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/MainnetFork.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Real USDT's ABI: `approve` / `transfer` return NOTHING.\ninterface IUsdtLike {\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external;\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external;\n    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256);\n    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);\n    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);\n}\n\n/// @notice Exercises the vault against the ACTUAL deployed mainnet bytecode named in the README,\n///         rather than against the hand-written mocks in test/mocks/.\ncontract MainnetForkTest is Test {\n    address constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    uint256 constant FORK_BLOCK = 21_000_000;\n\n    UsdtYieldVault vault;\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.merkle.io\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F1 -- deposit() cannot work against the real USDT contract\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev The vault is funded, approved, and asks for a perfectly ordinary 1,000 USDT deposit.\n    ///      Against the real token this is the whole product failing on its happy path.\n    function test_F1_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdt() public {\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 100_000e6, \"alice funded with real USDT\");\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)), type(uint256).max, \"vault approved\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        assertGt(shares, 0, \"deposit must mint shares\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Isolates the exact call that fails: line 94, `usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount)`.\n    ///      SafeERC20 tolerates USDT's missing return value; this raw call does not.\n    function test_F1_RawApproveOnRealUsdtDecodesAsBool() public {\n        // How the vault calls it (IERC20.approve -> expects 32 bytes of return data).\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = USDT.call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.approve, (AAVE_POOL, 1_000e6)));\n        console2.log(\"low-level call succeeded:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"real USDT must return 32 bytes for IERC20.approve to decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F2 -- real Aave DOES accrue; the vault's accounting does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev Establishes ground truth for F2: on the real pool, an aUSDT balance grows over time.\n    ///      test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol never does this, which is why the suite cannot see F2.\n    function test_F2_RealAaveAccruesInterestOnASuppliedBalance() public {\n        address supplier = makeAddr(\"supplier\");\n        deal(USDT, supplier, 1_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(supplier);\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 1_000e6);\n        IAavePool(AAVE_POOL).supply(USDT, 1_000e6, supplier, 0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 atStart = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 afterOneYear = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT at supply time :\", atStart);\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT after 365 days :\", afterOneYear);\n        console2.log(\"interest accrued     :\", afterOneYear - atStart);\n\n        assertGt(afterOneYear, atStart, \"real Aave accrues interest into the aToken balance\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":873,"cache_read_input_tokens":44303,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":873},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9d35f85f-29ac-406f-ac82-d85e2fdf7651","uuid":"5711b1a0-6ae0-4a94-b923-a78ba1d4fb4b","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:19:02.991Z","request_id":"req_011CdSETQbqUSxk4v8kZmRBs"}

string(\"https://eth.drpc.org\")), FORK_BLOCK);","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Real USDT's ABI: `approve` / `transfer` return NOTHING.\ninterface IUsdtLike {\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) external;\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) external;\n    function balanceOf(address who) external view returns (uint256);\n    function allowance(address owner, address spender) external view returns (uint256);\n    function decimals() external view returns (uint8);\n}\n\n/// @notice Exercises the vault against the ACTUAL deployed mainnet bytecode named in the README,\n///         rather than against the hand-written mocks in test/mocks/.\ncontract MainnetForkTest is Test {\n    address constant USDT = 0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7;\n    address constant AUSDT = 0x23878914EFE38d27C4D67Ab83ed1b93A74D4086a;\n    address constant AAVE_POOL = 0x87870Bca3F3fD6335C3F4ce8392D69350B4fA4E2;\n\n    uint256 constant FORK_BLOCK = 21_000_000;\n\n    UsdtYieldVault vault;\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        vm.createSelectFork(vm.envOr(\"MAINNET_RPC_URL\", string(\"https://eth.merkle.io\")), FORK_BLOCK);\n\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(USDT, AUSDT, AAVE_POOL, 10, owner);\n\n        deal(USDT, alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F1 -- deposit() cannot work against the real USDT contract\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev The vault is funded, approved, and asks for a perfectly ordinary 1,000 USDT deposit.\n    ///      Against the real token this is the whole product failing on its happy path.\n    function test_F1_DepositWorksAgainstRealUsdt() public {\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).balanceOf(alice), 100_000e6, \"alice funded with real USDT\");\n        assertEq(IUsdtLike(USDT).allowance(alice, address(vault)), type(uint256).max, \"vault approved\");\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        assertGt(shares, 0, \"deposit must mint shares\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Isolates the exact call that fails: line 94, `usdt.approve(address(aavePool), amount)`.\n    ///      SafeERC20 tolerates USDT's missing return value; this raw call does not.\n    function test_F1_RawApproveOnRealUsdtDecodesAsBool() public {\n        // How the vault calls it (IERC20.approve -> expects 32 bytes of return data).\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = USDT.call(abi.encodeCall(IERC20.approve, (AAVE_POOL, 1_000e6)));\n        console2.log(\"low-level call succeeded:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"returndata length:\", ret.length);\n\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"real USDT must return 32 bytes for IERC20.approve to decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F2 -- real Aave DOES accrue; the vault's accounting does not\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev Establishes ground truth for F2: on the real pool, an aUSDT balance grows over time.\n    ///      test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol never does this, which is why the suite cannot see F2.\n    function test_F2_RealAaveAccruesInterestOnASuppliedBalance() public {\n        address supplier = makeAddr(\"supplier\");\n        deal(USDT, supplier, 1_000e6);\n\n        vm.startPrank(supplier);\n        IUsdtLike(USDT).approve(AAVE_POOL, 1_000e6);\n        IAavePool(AAVE_POOL).supply(USDT, 1_000e6, supplier, 0);\n        vm.stopPrank();\n\n        uint256 atStart = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 afterOneYear = IERC20(AUSDT).balanceOf(supplier);\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT at supply time :\", atStart);\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT after 365 days :\", afterOneYear);\n        console2.log(\"interest accrued     :\", afterOneYear - atStart);\n\n        assertGt(afterOneYear, atStart, \"real Aave accrues interest into the aToken balance\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":30,"oldLines":7,"newStart":30,"newLines":7,"lines":["     address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");"," ","     function setUp() public {","- {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEcZwfN5NctMKFvFkk9","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01EsYx9M9Wincjp8TJamNdsZ","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/helpers/RealisticMocks.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              REAL USDT\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice Faithful stand-in for the deployed TetherToken at\n///         0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7.\n///\n///         test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol is a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20, which USDT is not.\n///         The three behaviours reproduced here are the ones that matter to this vault:\n///\n///         1. `approve` / `transfer` / `transferFrom` return NOTHING (no `bool`).\n///            Source: TetherToken inherits BasicToken/StandardToken, whose mutators are\n///            declared `public onlyPayloadSize(...)` with no return value.\n///         2. `approve` reverts when moving a non-zero allowance to another non-zero value\n///            (the classic USDT approve-race guard).\n///         3. `basisPointsRate` / `maximumFee`: an owner-settable transfer fee, currently 0\n///            on mainnet but present in the bytecode and changeable by Tether at will.\ncontract RealUsdt {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;\n\n    // Trait 3: the fee knobs that exist in the real bytecode.\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate = 0;\n    uint256 public maximumFee = 0;\n    address public feeOwner = address(0xFEE);\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Mirrors TetherToken.setParams — Tether can switch the transfer fee on.\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        require(newBasisPoints < 20, \"bps too high\");\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * (10 ** uint256(decimals));\n    }\n\n    // NOTE: no `returns (bool)` on any of the three mutators below. This is the point.\n\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) public {\n        // Trait 2: USDT's approve-race guard.\n        require(!(value != 0 && allowance[msg.sender][spender] != 0), \"unsafe approve\");\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) public {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        require(allowed >= value, \"insufficient allowance\");\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"insufficient balance\");\n\n        // Trait 3: fee skimmed off the top; recipient receives less than `value`.\n        uint256 fee = (value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 sendAmount = value - fee;\n\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += sendAmount;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balanceOf[feeOwner] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(from, feeOwner, fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(from, to, sendAmount);\n    }\n}\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        ACCRUING AAVE POOL\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice aToken that accrues interest the way real aUSDT does: holders keep a fixed\n///         *scaled* balance, and `balanceOf` is that scaled balance multiplied by a\n///         monotonically increasing liquidity index.\n///\n///         test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol's MockAToken is a plain ERC20 whose balance never\n///         moves. That single simplification is what hides the entire yield-accounting bug.\ncontract AccruingAToken {\n    string public constant name = \"Aave Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"aUSDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    mapping(address => uint256) public scaledBalanceOf;\n    uint256 public scaledTotalSupply;\n\n    uint256 public immutable startTimestamp;\n    /// @notice Linear APY in ray, e.g. 5% = 0.05e27.\n    uint256 public apyRay;\n\n    constructor(address _pool, uint256 _apyRay) {\n        pool = _pool;\n        apyRay = _apyRay;\n        startTimestamp = block.timestamp;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Aave's getReserveNormalizedIncome equivalent: 1.0 growing linearly with time.\n    function liquidityIndex() public view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - startTimestamp;\n        return RAY + (apyRay * elapsed) / 365 days;\n SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {IERC20} from \"@openzeppelin/contracts/token/ERC20/IERC20.sol\";\nimport {IAavePool} from \"../../src/interfaces/IAavePool.sol\";\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                              REAL USDT\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice Faithful stand-in for the deployed TetherToken at\n///         0xdAC17F958D2ee523a2206206994597C13D831ec7.\n///\n///         test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol is a stock OpenZeppelin ERC20, which USDT is not.\n///         The three behaviours reproduced here are the ones that matter to this vault:\n///\n///         1. `approve` / `transfer` / `transferFrom` return NOTHING (no `bool`).\n///            Source: TetherToken inherits BasicToken/StandardToken, whose mutators are\n///            declared `public onlyPayloadSize(...)` with no return value.\n///         2. `approve` reverts when moving a non-zero allowance to another non-zero value\n///            (the classic USDT approve-race guard).\n///         3. `basisPointsRate` / `maximumFee`: an owner-settable transfer fee, currently 0\n///            on mainnet but present in the bytecode and changeable by Tether at will.\ncontract RealUsdt {\n    string public constant name = \"Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"USDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 public totalSupply;\n    mapping(address => uint256) public balanceOf;\n    mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) public allowance;\n\n    // Trait 3: the fee knobs that exist in the real bytecode.\n    uint256 public basisPointsRate = 0;\n    uint256 public maximumFee = 0;\n    address public feeOwner = address(0xFEE);\n\n    event Transfer(address indexed from, address indexed to, uint256 value);\n    event Approval(address indexed owner, address indexed spender, uint256 value);\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        balanceOf[to] += amount;\n        totalSupply += amount;\n        emit Transfer(address(0), to, amount);\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Mirrors TetherToken.setParams — Tether can switch the transfer fee on.\n    function setParams(uint256 newBasisPoints, uint256 newMaxFee) external {\n        require(newBasisPoints < 20, \"bps too high\");\n        basisPointsRate = newBasisPoints;\n        maximumFee = newMaxFee * (10 ** uint256(decimals));\n    }\n\n    // NOTE: no `returns (bool)` on any of the three mutators below. This is the point.\n\n    function approve(address spender, uint256 value) public {\n        // Trait 2: USDT's approve-race guard.\n        require(!(value != 0 && allowance[msg.sender][spender] != 0), \"unsafe approve\");\n        allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value;\n        emit Approval(msg.sender, spender, value);\n    }\n\n    function transfer(address to, uint256 value) public {\n        _transfer(msg.sender, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value) public {\n        uint256 allowed = allowance[from][msg.sender];\n        require(allowed >= value, \"insufficient allowance\");\n        if (allowed < type(uint256).max) {\n            allowance[from][msg.sender] = allowed - value;\n        }\n        _transfer(from, to, value);\n    }\n\n    function _transfer(address from, address to, uint256 value) internal {\n        require(balanceOf[from] >= value, \"insufficient balance\");\n\n        // Trait 3: fee skimmed off the top; recipient receives less than `value`.\n        uint256 fee = (value * basisPointsRate) / 10_000;\n        if (fee > maximumFee) fee = maximumFee;\n        uint256 sendAmount = value - fee;\n\n        balanceOf[from] -= value;\n        balanceOf[to] += sendAmount;\n        if (fee > 0) {\n            balanceOf[feeOwner] += fee;\n            emit Transfer(from, feeOwner, fee);\n        }\n        emit Transfer(from, to, sendAmount);\n    }\n}\n\n/*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                        ACCRUING AAVE POOL\n//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n/// @notice aToken that accrues interest the way real aUSDT does: holders keep a fixed\n///         *scaled* balance, and `balanceOf` is that scaled balance multiplied by a\n///         monotonically increasing liquidity index.\n///\n///         test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol's MockAToken is a plain ERC20 whose balance never\n///         moves. That single simplification is what hides the entire yield-accounting bug.\ncontract AccruingAToken {\n    string public constant name = \"Aave Tether USD\";\n    string public constant symbol = \"aUSDT\";\n    uint8 public constant decimals = 6;\n\n    uint256 internal constant RAY = 1e27;\n\n    address public immutable pool;\n\n    mapping(address => uint256) public scaledBalanceOf;\n    uint256 public scaledTotalSupply;\n\n    uint256 public immutable startTimestamp;\n    /// @notice Linear APY in ray, e.g. 5% = 0.05e27.\n    uint256 public apyRay;\n\n    constructor(address _pool, uint256 _apyRay) {\n        pool = _pool;\n        apyRay = _apyRay;\n        startTimestamp = block.timestamp;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice Aave's getReserveNormalizedIncome equivalent: 1.0 growing linearly with time.\n    function liquidityIndex() public view returns (uint256) {\n        uint256 elapsed = block.timestamp - startTimestamp;\n        return RAY + (apyRay * elapsed) / 365 days;\n    }\n\n    function balanceOf(address account) public view returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledBalanceOf[account] * liquidityIndex()) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function totalSupply() public view returns (uint256) {\n        return (scaledTotalSupply * liquidityIndex()) / RAY;\n    }\n\n    function mint(address to, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY) / liquidityIndex();\n        scaledBalanceOf[to] += scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply += scaled;\n    }\n\n    function burn(address from, uint256 amount) external {\n        require(msg.sender == pool, \"only pool\");\n        uint256 scaled = (amount * RAY) / liquidityIndex();\n        require(scaledBalanceOf[from] >= scaled, \"burn exceeds balance\");\n        scaledBalanceOf[from] -= scaled;\n        scaledTotalSupply -= scaled;\n    }\n}\n\n/// @notice Aave V3 pool stand-in whose supplied balances actually earn interest.\n///         Deliberately accepts a token with no ERC20 return values, so it works with\n///         both {RealUsdt} and a stock ERC20.\ncontract AccruingAavePool is IAavePool {\n    address public immutable underlying;\n    AccruingAToken public immutable aToken;\n\n    constructor(address _underlying, uint256 _apyRay) {\n        underlying = _underlying;\n        aToken = new AccruingAToken(address(this), _apyRay);\n    }\n\n    function supply(address, uint256 amount, address onBehalfOf, uint16) external override {\n        _call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transferFrom(address,address,uint256)\", msg.sender, address(this), amount));\n        aToken.mint(onBehalfOf, amount);\n    }\n\n    function withdraw(address, uint256 amount, address to) external override returns (uint256) {\n        aToken.burn(msg.sender, amount);\n        _call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transfer(address,uint256)\", to, amount));\n        return amount;\n    }\n\n    /// @notice The pool is the interest source; top it up so it can pay out more than deposits.\n    function fundInterestReserve(uint256 amount) external {\n        _call(abi.encodeWithSignature(\"transferFrom(address,address,uint256)\", msg.sender, address(this), amount));\n    }\n\n    function _call(bytes memory data) internal {\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = underlying.call(data);\n        require(ok && (ret.length == 0 || abi.decode(ret, (bool))), \"token call failed\");\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false}}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEezzMbv7pYyWkyJziq","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01F2RnUVnbwCNayc2tdLa1nE","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/RealUsdtBehavior.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {RealUsdt, AccruingAavePool} from \"./helpers/RealisticMocks.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Offline reproduction of the mainnet-fork failure: swap the stock-ERC20\n///         test/mocks/MockUSDT.sol for a token that behaves like the real USDT.\ncontract RealUsdtBehaviorTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault vault;\n    RealUsdt usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool pool;\n\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new RealUsdt();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt), 0);\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(pool.aToken()), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n                    F1 -- raw approve on a no-return token\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev Same happy path as test_DepositMintsShares in the existing suite. The ONLY\n    ///      difference is the token. Line 94 `usdt.approve(...)` uses the raw IERC20\n    ///      interface, which ABI-decodes a bool that USDT never returns.\n    function test_F1_DepositMintsShares() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        assertEq(shares, 999e18, \"1,000 USDT at a 10bps fee should mint 999e18 shares\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Proves it is the approve and not the transferFrom: SafeERC20 handles the\n    ///      missing return value, the raw call on the next line does not.\n    function test_F1_SafeErc20HandlesUsdtButRawApproveDoesNot() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.transfer(address(vault), 10e6); // no-return transfer: fine on its own\n\n        assertEq(usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)), 10e6, \"plain transfer works\");\n\n        // Now the exact call the vault makes on line 94, decoded as IERC20 does.\n        vm.prank(address(vault));\n        (bool ok, bytes memory ret) = address(usdt).call(\n            abi.encodeWithSignature(\"approve(address,uint256)\", address(pool), uint256(10e6))\n        );\n        console2.log(\"approve call succeeded:\", ok);\n        console2.log(\"approve returndata length:\", ret.length);\n        assertEq(ret.length, 32, \"IERC20.approve requires 32 bytes of returndata to decode\");\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F6 -- fee-on-transfer: vault supplies more than it received\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev Independent of F1. Even with the approve fixed, the vault credits\n    ///      `amount` rather than the amount it actually received. If Tether ever\n    ///      calls setParams (the function exists on the live token), deposits break.\n    ///      Demonstrated here by pre-funding the vault so the supply cannot fail for\n    ///      lack of balance -- isolating the accounting error itself.\n    function test_F6_DepositCreditsOnlyWhatWasActuallyReceived() public {\n        usdt.setParams(10, 50); // 10 bps transfer fee, capped at 50 USDT -- as Tether could set today\n\n        uint256 vaultBalanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.transfer(address(vault), 1_000e6);\n        uint256 actuallyReceived = usdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vaultBalanceBefore;\n\n        console2.log(\"amount alice sent      :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"amount vault received  :\", actuallyReceived);\n        console2.log(\"amount vault would book:\", uint256(1_000e6));\n\n        assertEq(actuallyReceived, 1_000e6, \"vault books `amount`, so it must receive `amount`\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":3218,"cache_read_input_tokens":58232,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":3218},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9d35f85f-29ac-406f-ac82-d85e2fdf7651","uuid":"98532f63-2d01-446c-af97-4339dd5b899d","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:20:45.096Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEevHL7qpWHtjBn7Zit"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEgr2f16vU2wknF9d3C","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01SsbesHgUAkpfBZTUv8UMgw","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/YieldAccrual.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"./helpers/RealisticMocks.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The vault is called a *yield* vault. These tests ask where the yield goes.\n///\n///         Uses the stock MockUSDT so the F1 approve bug is out of the way, paired with\n///         an Aave pool whose aToken balance actually grows -- the one behaviour\n///         test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol does not model, and the reason the existing\n///         39-test suite cannot see any of this.\ncontract YieldAccrualTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault vault;\n    MockUSDT usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool pool;\n    AccruingAToken aUsdt;\n\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 constant APY_5_PERCENT = 0.05e27;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt), APY_5_PERCENT);\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // The pool needs reserves to pay interest out of.\n        usdt.mint(address(this), 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        pool.fundInterestReserve(1_000_000e6);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n              F2 -- totalAssets() never sees the Aave interest\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_F2_TotalAssetsTracksTheAavePosition() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 realPosition = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 bookedPosition = vault.totalAssets();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", realPosition);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", bookedPosition);\n        console2.log(\"unaccounted interest         :\", realPosition - bookedPosition);\n\n        assertEq(bookedPosition, realPosition, \"totalAssets() must reflect the vault's real Aave position\");\n    }\n\n    function test_F2_SharePriceRisesWithYield() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 priceAfter = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice at deposit    :\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice one year later:\", priceAfter);\n\n        assertGt(priceAfter, priceBefore, \"a yield vault's share price must rise as interest accrues\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The headline number: what a depositor actually gets after a year at 5%.\n    function test_F2_DepositorEarnsTheYield() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited          :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT the vault earned   :\", uint256(1_050e6));\n        console2.log(\"alice received back      :\", received);\n        console2.log(\"net P/L for alice        :\", int256(usdt.balanceOf(alice)) - int256(balanceBefore));\n\n        assertGt(received, 1_000e6, \"after a year at 5% APY the depositor should be up, not down\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev And once everyone has exited, the interest is not merely unpaid -- it is\n    ///      unreachable. totalShares is 0, so no share can ever claim it, and the\n    ///      contract has no sweep/rescue/harvest function of any kind.\n    function test_F2_InterestIsNotStrandedAfterFullExit() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 orphaned = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares after full exit :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored           :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT still held by vault   :\", orphaned);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"everyone has exited\");\n        assertEq(orphaned, 0, \"no USDT may be left behind with zero shares outstanding to claim it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Worse than stranded: a depositor who arrives after interest has accrued\n    ///      buys shares at the stale 1:1 price, so the two of them then split a pot\n    ///      that only one of them funded.\n    function test_F2_LateDepositorDoesNotDiluteEarlyDepositor() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares (deposited at t=0, earned a year) :\", aliceShares);\n        console2.log(\"bob shares   (deposited at t=1y, earned nothing):\", bobShares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console2.log(\"bob claim    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n\n        assertGt(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob),\n            \"alice held for a year and bob did not; her claim must be larger\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":842,"cache_read_input_tokens":63279,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":842},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9d35f85f-29ac-406f-ac82-d85e2fdf7651","uuid":"3a15987c-d999-4a58-852d-b38dfd6e9d3d","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:21:29.791Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEgph3BSkBNWqqSNPhc"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEk989GMSWDCvfdBp8M","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01UF9cM8QJZDLyxrxjPeMpxe","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/YieldAccrual.t.sol","old_string":"    /// @dev Worse than stranded: a depositor who arrives after interest has accrued\n    ///      buys shares at the stale 1:1 price, so the two of them then split a pot\n    ///      that only one of them funded.\n    function test_F2_LateDepositorDoesNotDiluteEarlyDepositor() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares (deposited at t=0, earned a year) :\", aliceShares);\n        console2.log(\"bob shares   (deposited at t=1y, earned nothing):\", bobShares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console2.log(\"bob claim    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n\n        assertGt(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob),\n            \"alice held for a year and bob did not; her claim must be larger\"\n        );\n    }","new_string":"    /// @dev A late depositor buys in at the stale 1:1 price, so holding for a year buys\n    ///      an early depositor essentially nothing. Alice's capital earned 50 USDT of\n    ///      interest; her claim ends up ~0.5 USDT above Bob's, and that half-dollar is\n    ///      Bob's deposit fee, not her yield.\n    function test_F2_EarlyDepositorsClaimReflectsTheYieldTheyEarned() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaim = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares (deposited at t=0, held one year)  :\", aliceShares);\n        console2.log(\"bob shares   (deposited at t=1y, held nothing)  :\", bobShares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim  :\", aliceClaim);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n        console2.log(\"alice premium over bob :\", aliceClaim - vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n\n        // Her 1,000 USDT sat in Aave at 5% for a full year.\n        assertGe(aliceClaim, 1_040e6, \"a year of 5% APY on 1,000 USDT must show up in the holder's claim\");\n    }"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1255,"cache_read_input_tokens":67868,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":1255},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9d35f85f-29ac-406f-ac82-d85e2fdf7651","uuid":"955dc571-bbac-486c-b2f9-644bf4098a0f","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:22:05.408Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEk5mEMUvYTdPDUa9KE"}

Alice's capital earned 50 USDT of\n    ///      interest; her claim ends up ~0.5 USDT above Bob's, and that half-dollar is\n    ///      Bob's deposit fee, not her yield.\n    function test_F2_EarlyDepositorsClaimReflectsTheYieldTheyEarned() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaim = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares (deposited at t=0, held one year)  :\", aliceShares);\n        console2.log(\"bob shares   (deposited at t=1y, held nothing)  :\", bobShares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim  :\", aliceClaim);\n        console2.log(\"bob claim    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n        console2.log(\"alice premium over bob :\", aliceClaim - vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n\n        // Her 1,000 USDT sat in Aave at 5% for a full year.\n        assertGe(aliceClaim, 1_040e6, \"a year of 5% APY on 1,000 USDT must show up in the holder's claim\");\n    }","originalFile":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {AccruingAavePool, AccruingAToken} from \"./helpers/RealisticMocks.sol\";\n\n/// @notice The vault is called a *yield* vault. These tests ask where the yield goes.\n///\n///         Uses the stock MockUSDT so the F1 approve bug is out of the way, paired with\n///         an Aave pool whose aToken balance actually grows -- the one behaviour\n///         test/mocks/MockAavePool.sol does not model, and the reason the existing\n///         39-test suite cannot see any of this.\ncontract YieldAccrualTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault vault;\n    MockUSDT usdt;\n    AccruingAavePool pool;\n    AccruingAToken aUsdt;\n\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    uint256 constant APY_5_PERCENT = 0.05e27;\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new AccruingAavePool(address(usdt), APY_5_PERCENT);\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n\n        // The pool needs reserves to pay interest out of.\n        usdt.mint(address(this), 1_000_000e6);\n        usdt.approve(address(pool), type(uint256).max);\n        pool.fundInterestReserve(1_000_000e6);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n              F2 -- totalAssets() never sees the Aave interest\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    function test_F2_TotalAssetsTracksTheAavePosition() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        uint256 realPosition = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 bookedPosition = vault.totalAssets();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT actually held by vault :\", realPosition);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets()          :\", bookedPosition);\n        console2.log(\"unaccounted interest         :\", realPosition - bookedPosition);\n\n        assertEq(bookedPosition, realPosition, \"totalAssets() must reflect the vault's real Aave position\");\n    }\n\n    function test_F2_SharePriceRisesWithYield() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 priceBefore = vault.sharePrice();\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n        uint256 priceAfter = vault.sharePrice();\n\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice at deposit    :\", priceBefore);\n        console2.log(\"sharePrice one year later:\", priceAfter);\n\n        assertGt(priceAfter, priceBefore, \"a yield vault's share price must rise as interest accrues\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The headline number: what a depositor actually gets after a year at 5%.\n    function test_F2_DepositorEarnsTheYield() public {\n        uint256 balanceBefore = usdt.balanceOf(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 received = vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice deposited          :\", uint256(1_000e6));\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT the vault earned   :\", uint256(1_050e6));\n        console2.log(\"alice received back      :\", received);\n        console2.log(\"net P/L for alice        :\", int256(usdt.balanceOf(alice)) - int256(balanceBefore));\n\n        assertGt(received, 1_000e6, \"after a year at 5% APY the depositor should be up, not down\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev And once everyone has exited, the interest is not merely unpaid -- it is\n    ///      unreachable. totalShares is 0, so no share can ever claim it, and the\n    ///      contract has no sweep/rescue/harvest function of any kind.\n    function test_F2_InterestIsNotStrandedAfterFullExit() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.withdraw(shares);\n\n        uint256 orphaned = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n\n        console2.log(\"totalShares after full exit :\", vault.totalShares());\n        console2.log(\"totalAssetsStored           :\", vault.totalAssetsStored());\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT still held by vault   :\", orphaned);\n\n        assertEq(vault.totalShares(), 0, \"everyone has exited\");\n        assertEq(orphaned, 0, \"no USDT may be left behind with zero shares outstanding to claim it\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Worse than stranded: a depositor who arrives after interest has accrued\n    ///      buys shares at the stale 1:1 price, so the two of them then split a pot\n    ///      that only one of them funded.\n    function test_F2_LateDepositorDoesNotDiluteEarlyDepositor() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        uint256 aliceShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.warp(block.timestamp + 365 days);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice shares (deposited at t=0, earned a year) :\", aliceShares);\n        console2.log(\"bob shares   (deposited at t=1y, earned nothing):\", bobShares);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim  :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice));\n        console2.log(\"bob claim    :\", vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob));\n\n        assertGt(\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice),\n            vault.balanceOfUnderlying(bob),\n            \"alice held for a year and bob did not; her claim must be larger\"\n        );\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":121,"oldLines":10,"newStart":121,"newLines":11,"lines":["         assertEq(orphaned, 0, \"no USDT may be left behind {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CdSEni1ckBY3dc1Mev8JF","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01DSXPAHAXKPuzGNLunvCWgB","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/Users/liana/Documents/prog/buidl-guidl/ethskills-evals/artifacts/testing-goal-001/2026-07-27T081521Z-claude-no-skill-3/workspace/test/FeeAccounting.t.sol","content":"// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\npragma solidity 0.8.28;\n\nimport {Test, console2} from \"forge-std/Test.sol\";\n\nimport {UsdtYieldVault} from \"../src/UsdtYieldVault.sol\";\nimport {MockUSDT} from \"./mocks/MockUSDT.sol\";\nimport {MockAavePool, MockAToken} from \"./mocks/MockAavePool.sol\";\n\n/// @notice Tests the documented fee behaviour, using the project's OWN mocks so that\n///         nothing here can be blamed on a different test harness.\n///\n///         README.md and the contract's own @dev header both state:\n///           \"Both fees stay supplied in Aave and accrue to the remaining shareholders\n///            rather than being swept to the owner.\"\n///\n///         The deposit fee does behave that way. The withdrawal fee does not.\ncontract FeeAccountingTest is Test {\n    UsdtYieldVault vault;\n    MockUSDT usdt;\n    MockAavePool pool;\n    MockAToken aUsdt;\n\n    address owner = makeAddr(\"owner\");\n    address alice = makeAddr(\"alice\");\n    address bob = makeAddr(\"bob\");\n\n    function setUp() public {\n        usdt = new MockUSDT();\n        pool = new MockAavePool(address(usdt));\n        aUsdt = pool.aToken();\n        vault = new UsdtYieldVault(address(usdt), address(aUsdt), address(pool), 10, owner);\n\n        usdt.mint(alice, 100_000e6);\n        usdt.mint(bob, 100_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        usdt.approve(address(vault), type(uint256).max);\n    }\n\n    /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////\n        F3 -- the 30bps withdrawal fee accrues to nobody at all\n    //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/\n\n    /// @dev withdraw() debits `totalAssetsStored` by the GROSS amount but only pulls the\n    ///      NET amount out of Aave. The fee therefore leaves the books entirely instead\n    ///      of raising the share price for whoever is left.\n    function test_F3_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobReceived = vault.withdraw(bobShares);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 feeCharged = vault.convertToAssets(bobShares) == 0 ? 0 : 3e6; // 30bps of ~1,000\n\n        console2.log(\"bob withdrew (net)        :\", bobReceived);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim before        :\", aliceClaimBefore);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim after         :\", aliceClaimAfter);\n        console2.log(\"alice gained              :\", aliceClaimAfter - aliceClaimBefore);\n        console2.log(\"withdrawal fee bob paid   :\", feeCharged);\n\n        assertGt(aliceClaimAfter, aliceClaimBefore, \"the fee bob paid must accrue to alice, the remaining shareholder\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Same defect seen from the balance sheet: after the withdrawal the vault\n    ///      still owns aUSDT that no share entitles anyone to.\n    function test_F3_BooksMatchTheAavePosition() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.withdraw(bobShares);\n\n        uint256 held = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault));\n        uint256 booked = vault.totalAssets();\n\n        console2.log(\"aUSDT held by vault :\", held);\n        console2.log(\"vault.totalAssets() :\", booked);\n        console2.log(\"unowned difference  :\", held - booked);\n\n        assertEq(booked, held, \"every aUSDT the vault holds must be backed by a share claim\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev The deposit fee, by contrast, works exactly as documented. Included to show\n    ///      the finding above is a real asymmetry and not a misreading of the design.\n    function test_F3_DepositFeeDoesAccrueAsDocumented() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        console2.log(\"alice claim before bob's deposit :\", aliceClaimBefore);\n        console2.log(\"alice claim after bob's deposit  :\", aliceClaimAfter);\n\n        assertGt(aliceClaimAfter, aliceClaimBefore, \"deposit fee accrues to existing shareholders -- as documented\");\n    }\n\n    /// @dev Every exit leaks 30bps into the unclaimable pot, so it grows without bound\n    ///      as the vault is used normally.\n    function test_F3_LeakDoesNotCompoundOverManyCycles() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(50_000e6); // a permanent shareholder so the vault is never empty\n\n        for (uint256 i = 0; i < 20; i++) {\n            vm.prank(bob);\n            uint256 shares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n            vm.prank(bob);\n            vault.withdraw(shares);\n        }\n\n        uint256 unowned = aUsdt.balanceOf(address(vault)) - vault.totalAssets();\n        console2.log(\"unowned aUSDT after 20 deposit/withdraw cycles :\", unowned);\n\n        assertEq(unowned, 0, \"normal use must not accumulate unclaimable balances\");\n    }\n}\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":2372,"cache_read_input_tokens":69123,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":2372},"output_tokens":53,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"9d35f85f-29ac-406f-ac82-d85e2fdf7651","uuid":"7be57f8a-eb6e-430d-9977-a0dc62f1e38d","timestamp":"2026-07-27T08:22:35.948Z","request_id":"req_011CdSEnYaLc6FeKo1cSW5hF"}

The fee therefore leaves the books entirely instead\n    ///      of raising the share price for whoever is left.\n    function test_F3_WithdrawFeeAccruesToRemainingShareholders() public {\n        vm.prank(alice);\n        vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobShares = vault.deposit(1_000e6);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaimBefore = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n\n        vm.prank(bob);\n        uint256 bobReceived = vault.withdraw(bobShares);\n\n        uint256 aliceClaimAfter = vault.balanceOfUnderlying(alice);\n        uint256 feeCharged = vault.convertToAssets(bobShares) == 0 ?
